# Dr. Lal PathLabs — Patient Service Centre, Khargapur, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow

> Authorized Patient Service Centre (franchise) of Dr. Lal PathLabs in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.
> This is NOT the official corporate website of Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd. For the corporate site, see https://www.lalpathlabs.com.

## About
- Name: Dr. Lal PathLabs – Patient Service Centre, Khargapur
- Address: Khargapur, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226010, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9451155402
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM; Sun 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM
- Lab: NABL-accredited processing; reports in 24–48 hours via email, WhatsApp and portal
- Home sample collection: FREE across Lucknow, 7 days a week, by trained phlebotomists

## Services
- Blood tests: CBC, Blood Sugar (Fasting/PP/Random), HbA1c, Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3/T4/TSH), Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, Iron studies, Fever Panel, Dengue NS1, Typhoid, Urine routine
- Health checkup packages: Super 1 (40 tests, ₹1250), Super 2 (60 tests, ₹1550), Super 3 (75 tests, ₹2250), Super 4 (90 tests, ₹2550)
- Free home sample collection across Lucknow localities
